name: MsoFileDialogView
description: Specifies the view presented to the user in a file dialog box.

constants.name: msoFileDialogViewList
constants.description: Files displayed in a list without details.

constants.name: msoFileDialogViewDetails
constants.description: Files displayed in a list with detail information.

constants.name: msoFileDialogViewProperties
constants.description: Files displayed in a list with a pane showing the selected file's properties.

constants.name: msoFileDialogViewPreview
constants.description: Files displayed in a list with a preview pane showing the selected file.
